text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
choice_data_list: Looks like you're in great shape this morning.
Looks like you're doing great this morning.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I slept like a baby, and I even went marvelous-hunting first thing this morning☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
And then, I found a little bird that fell out of its nest,
and I put it right back in.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The mama bird said thank you
and sang me a song in return☆
La la la~ What a wonderful girl~♪

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"There's so much marvelous here and there today too!
A marvelous to all these wonderful encounters☆★☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous Sunday was high-spirited from the early morning.
It seems she had quite a fulfilling day off.
